name: brineprop_secondary_refrigerants
title: BrineProp: thermophysical properties of aqueous secondary refrigerants (function library)
summary: Freezing point, density, specific heat, thermal conductivity and dynamic viscosity of eleven aqueous secondary refrigerants (EG, PG, EA, MA, GL, NH3, K2CO3, CaCl2, MgCl2, NaCl, KAc) versus mass concentration and temperature, from the 18-term polynomials of the ULiège BrineProp library: a function BrineProperty in SI units, and the EES procedures BRINEPROP and BRINEPROP2 as wrappers of it.
language_features: FUNCTION with string arguments, called in equations and by procedures
lookup tables read inside a function
CALL ERROR with a formatted value

authors: TBD (ULiège Thermodynamics Laboratory; the EES help file of the library credits its 1997 edition and refers to IIR thermo-physical data but names no person; the inventory attributes the library to the laboratory, J. Lebrun et al.)
origin.ees_version: Brineprop.lib X7.793 (compiled library stamp $SB1); Brineprop2.LIB X9.513 ($SB2); lookup tables W4.631; rewritten for CoolSolve 2026-11-05
origin.course: ULiège model bank (Laborelec toolkit lineage), Model data bank / AHU_Components, 1997

verification.summary: BRINEPROP against the stored solution of the glycol run-around loop model of the same library, BRINEPROP2 against the stored solution of the Vitocal heat pump model (CSL-0116): 9 common variables, 0 differ (rtol=0.001), maximum relative difference 4.77e-10 (rho_brine_2). The rewrite on one function gives the values of the EES procedures (0.0 on cases 1-4).
verification.reference: EES stored solutions: the glycol run-around loop reference model of the same library (GLYCOLRECOVERYLOOP_RefSim_EES_Model_SB080116.EES, EES 7.888, inventory TM-0476), BRINEPROP for ethylene glycol 25 % at t_gw_m = 6.324036551 °C (rho_gw, c_p_gw, mu_gw); the Vitocal 300-G heat pump model (HeatPump_Vitocal 300G -110_CGSQ1112288.EES, CSL-0116), BRINEPROP2 for ethylene glycol 30 % at -5 °C (its six outputs)
verification.notes: 9 common variables, 0 differ (rtol=0.001); maximum relative difference 4.77e-10 (rho_brine_2), from the 80-bit to 64-bit rounding of the hand-decoded coefficient tables (BRINEPROP2: rho_brine_3 3.6e-10, T_freeze_3 1.8e-10, c_p_brine_3_kJ 1.1e-10, k, mu, Pr below 2e-11). No reference variable excluded; cases 1, 4, 5 and the other outputs of case 2 have no EES reference. The routines are a 2026-11-05 rewrite of the EES procedures (one SI function BrineProperty, BRINEPROP and BRINEPROP2 as wrappers): same values as the EES text on the 32 variables of cases 1-4 (0.0), and the library models that call them (CSL-0072, CSL-0078, CSL-0161, CSL-0162, CSL-0163) reproduce their baselines (<= 1.4e-8). The decode reproduces the CSL-0072 reference point (EG 25 % at 25 °C) to 2.9e-09 (rho) and 6.2e-09 (c_p), and the stale T_freezing of the CSL-0161 source file (BRINEPROP2, EG 25 % at 25 °C) to 6e-11.
